title: A Regularization Based Computational Method for Quantum Incommensurate Problems
summary: Quantum incommensurate systems have attracted widespread interest due to their unique physical properties. Related studies have made notable progress in recent years. To gain deeper insight, it is both significant and challenging to study a broader range of physical observables for these systems, which requires a comprehensive understanding of their spectral properties and wavefunction behavior. Based on the regularized model recently proposed, this work introduces a regularization framework, rendering physical observables for incommensurate systems mathematically well-defined and…
